title: Link replay spec permits IID-only and unauthenticated state poisoning
description: spec/02-physical-link.md keys replay acceptance only by IID and does not require signature verification before replay-state mutation, despite unsigned frames and spec/03 requiring full verified signer identity/generation plus authenticate-before-context-mutation. Define replay domain as full authenticated signer/key generation (with address only as routing metadata), verification before mutation, atomic persistence, and old-generation invalidation; align replay vectors with unsigned poisoning, alias, rotation, and rollback cases.
